ai.seo_question: Who are the primary family members mentioned in this Quranic phrase regarding inheritance?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Ma'arij, this phrase highlights the intimate social bonds of the individual on the Day of Judgment, where one will be asked about their 'wife and brother' as primary examples of close kinship. Shia exegetes often interpret this as a reference to the specific familial ties that carry moral weight in accountability, emphasizing the rights of the spouse and sibling within the nuclear family structure.
